company_name.description: The company's legal name, printed on the invoice.

vat_id.description: The company's VAT ID, or `null` for none. Required for a new purchase in another EU country; direct VIES must confirm it with an identifier.

tax_id.description: Free-text Tax ID. Required for a new non-EU purchase; historical records may omit it.

line1.description: Street and number, or the first address line.

line2.description: A second address line, or `null` when there is none.

country.description: The billing country, used for purchase eligibility and VAT.

state.description: State or region. A new US purchase requires a two-letter state code; historical addresses may omit it.

invoice_email.description: Where invoices and billing mail are sent.

description: New company purchase. Other EU countries require VAT ID; non-EU requires Tax ID; US requires two-letter state. Cloud additionally checks the versioned public-email policy and current VIES evidence.
